title: ProjectSubmittedPayload
description: Payload for eventforge.project.submitted — starts the dataset pipeline.

name.description: Human-readable project name; persisted on the Job row (jobs.name).

schema_json.description: Annotation output schema (JSON Schema or field map).

schema_template.description: Optional preset template id, e.g. support_call, support_call_audio, or document_classification.

domain.description: Project content domain (e.g. documents, audio); persisted on Job.domain.

asset_count.description: Optional number of uploaded assets known at submit time.
